QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_34

question.text: Per the Code of Conduct for AIF Managers and their key management personnel (SEBI AIF Regulations), which of the following is EXPLICITLY required?

answer.text: Guarantee minimum annual returns to investors
Share investee-company confidential information with competitors for price discovery
Record in writing, the investment, divestment and other key decisions, together with appropriate justification for such decisions
Avoid all regulatory compliance that impedes speed

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the SEBI Code of Conduct (workbook page 248), AIF managers and their key management personnel must record in writing the investment, divestment and other key decisions, together with appropriate justification for such decisions. This documentation requirement is the source-supported written-record obligation under the Code of Conduct. The Trap: Guaranteeing returns is prohibited for AIFs. Sharing investee-company confidential information with competitors breaches confidentiality obligations. 'Avoiding all regulatory compliance' is plainly contrary to the Code of Conduct. Note: The Code of Conduct on pages 247-249 sets out the broader fiduciary and documentation duties applicable to managers and KMPs. The written-record-with-justification obligation is the specific item tested here.
